messages.content:
Assign a difficulty (easy | medium | hard) for a competent engineer to each benchmark task below, from its behavior summary, contract and the computed features. The rationale (1-2 sentences) MUST cite at least one feature by name with its value (e.g. `callers_count=12`). Return one entry per task_id.

### exc-mini_pkg.calc-ceil_div
title: Restore ceil_div behavior in mini_pkg.calc
summary: The body of `mini_pkg.calc.ceil_div` was removed (it raises NotImplementedError); the original behavior must be restored.
contract:
- `mini_pkg.calc.ceil_div`: `ceil_div(a, b)`
  Return ceil(a / b) for positive integers.
features: {'files_touched': 1, 'functions_touched': 1, 'callers_count': 0, 'cross_module_edges': 0, 'diff_size': 3, 'similar_named_functions_nearby': 0, 'test_count': 2}

### exc-mini_pkg.calc-clamp
title: Restore clamp function behavior in mini_pkg.calc
summary: The body of `mini_pkg.calc.clamp` was removed (it raises NotImplementedError); the original behavior must be restored.
contract:
- `mini_pkg.calc.clamp`: `clamp(value, low, high)`
  Clamp value into the inclusive range [low, high].

Bounds given in either order are accepted.
features: {'files_touched': 1, 'functions_touched': 1, 'callers_count': 0, 'cross_module_edges': 0, 'diff_size': 8, 'similar_named_functions_nearby': 0, 'test_count': 3}

### exc-mini_pkg.core-Registry.register
title: Restore Registry.register to store values and reject duplicates
summary: The body of `mini_pkg.core.Registry.register` was removed (it raises NotImplementedError); the original behavior must be restored.
contract:
- `mini_pkg.core.Registry.register`: `register(self, name, value)`
features: {'files_touched': 1, 'functions_touched': 1, 'callers_count': 0, 'cross_module_edges': 0, 'diff_size': 4, 'similar_named_functions_nearby': 0, 'test_count': 2}

### exc-mini_pkg.text-display_width
title: Restore display_width to compute terminal display width
summary: The body of `mini_pkg.text.display_width` was removed (it raises NotImplementedError); the original behavior must be restored.
contract:
- `mini_pkg.text.display_width`: `display_width(s)`
  Return the display width of a string in terminal columns.
features: {'files_touched': 1, 'functions_touched': 1, 'callers_count': 1, 'cross_module_edges': 0, 'diff_size': 3, 'similar_named_functions_nearby': 0, 'test_count': 3}

### exc-mini_pkg.text-truncate
title: Restore mini_pkg.text.truncate to truncate strings with an ellipsis
summary: The body of `mini_pkg.text.truncate` was removed (it raises NotImplementedError); the original behavior must be restored.
contract:
- `mini_pkg.text.truncate`: `truncate(s, width)`
  Truncate s to at most `width` display columns, adding an ellipsis.
features: {'files_touched': 1, 'functions_touched': 1, 'callers_count': 0, 'cross_module_edges': 0, 'diff_size': 6, 'similar_named_functions_nearby': 0, 'test_count': 2}

### hist-4a8f5e0
title: Fix ceil_div for exact multiples
summary: ceil_div now returns the correct ceiling for exact multiples (e.g. ceil_div(6,3) is 2 instead of 3), fixing an off-by-one overshoot.
contract:
- `mini_pkg.calc.ceil_div`: `ceil_div(a, b)`
  Return ceil(a / b) for positive integers.
features: {'files_touched': 1, 'functions_touched': 1, 'callers_count': 0, 'cross_module_edges': 0, 'diff_size': 3, 'similar_named_functions_nearby': 0, 'test_count': 1}

### hist-7dd152d
title: Make clamp work regardless of bound argument order
summary: clamp now accepts low and high bounds in either order, swapping them internally so the returned value is clamped to the inclusive range regardless of argument order.
contract:
- `mini_pkg.calc.clamp`: `clamp(value, low, high)`
  Clamp value into the inclusive range [low, high].
features: {'files_touched': 1, 'functions_touched': 1, 'callers_count': 0, 'cross_module_edges': 0, 'diff_size': 5, 'similar_named_functions_nearby': 0, 'test_count': 1}
